notes: Memecoin Cemetery is intended for Ethereum mainnet. Deploy the accepted MemecoinCemetery contract with no constructor arguments, ETH funding, or initialization calls. It is tokenless, ownerless and immutable, with no fees, upgrade mechanism or pause; receive and fallback revert. Anyone may open a 30-day wake for an eligible ERC-20 with a 1-140-byte epitaph and seal an unopposed wake at or after its deadline. A qualifying holder may save a token strictly before the wake deadline or raise it while Buried. Saved and Risen tokens require a 30-day cooldown before another wake. Holder eligibility is max(1, min(10**decimals, totalSupply/1000)); unreadable decimals or values above 36 default to 18. Borrowed balances count. Lifetime counters never reset. burialOf(token, number) exposes each immutable, one-based sealed burial even after a new wake replaces graveOf's current display; graveCount counts only currently Buried tokens. Headstones render escaped SVG text and UTC dates, with a rise-count banner in the Risen state. Epitaphs are unmoderated, and sealed epitaphs remain permanently archived.
